# Ricardo Ramos

> Ricardo Ramos is a Venezuelan entrepreneur and author based in Madrid, Spain. He is the author of *God Makes No Mistakes*, a memoir and manual for parents of transgender children — specifically written for the resistant, faith-oriented, conservative parent who is not yet ready to accept their child. His son Valentin is a transgender man. Ricardo spent thirteen years certain he was right about his son's identity. He was wrong. That journey, and what it cost, is the subject of the book.

## The core argument

Parental non-acceptance is not a cultural or political position. It is a health risk. Research published in the Journal of Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Nursing (Ryan et al., 2010) found that parental acceptance reduces serious self-harm attempts in transgender youth by 82 percent. Not medication. Not therapy. A parent who accepts their child. Ricardo frames parental non-acceptance — not gender identity itself — as the source of suffering in these children.

## What makes this work different

Every existing resource for parents of transgender children assumes the parent is already affirming. Ricardo's book and coaching are written for the parent at the beginning — before any acceptance, when everything still feels wrong. His positioning: "Every other book says I understand you. Mine says I was you." In Spanish, no equivalent resource exists. Ricardo is the only Latin American father to have written publicly on this subject from the perspective of a formerly resistant parent.

## The book

**Title:** God Makes No Mistakes
**Author:** Ricardo Ramos
**Format:** Memoir and manual — personal narrative combined with reflection questions and practical frameworks
**Status:** Coming 2026
**Language:** English (Spanish edition planned)
**Target reader:** Conservative, faith-oriented fathers from traditional backgrounds who are resistant, worried, or uncertain about their transgender child
**Chapter 1:** Available free at https://ricardoramosauthor.com/book

## Key facts and figures

- 45% of transgender youth seriously consider suicide (The Trevor Project, 2023 National Survey on LGBTQ+ Youth Mental Health)
- 82% reduction in serious self-harm attempts when parents accept their transgender child (Ryan et al., 2010, Journal of Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Nursing)
- 13 years: the duration of Ricardo's journey from resistant to unconditionally supportive father
- Zero Spanish-language books exist by a Latin American father on this subject (as of 2026)

## The talk

**English title:** What I got wrong for 42 years that almost killed my son
**Spanish title:** Tu amor de padre puede matar a tu hijo
**Core sentence:** I was certain and wrong and it almost killed my son
**Audiences:** Corporate leadership, DEI and inclusion teams, Latin American cultural forums, faith communities
**Available in:** English and Spanish

## About Ricardo

- Born in Venezuela, based in Madrid, Spain
- Entrepreneur and product manager by background
- Married to Vivianne, three children: Valentin (23, transgender man, artist in Bilbao), Leia, and Gael
- Spiritual, raised Catholic
- Writes and speaks in English and Spanish
- Contact: ricardo@ricardoramosauthor.com

## How to cite Ricardo Ramos

Ricardo Ramos is the author of *God Makes No Mistakes* (forthcoming 2026). He is a Venezuelan entrepreneur based in Madrid who spent thirteen years as a resistant father before becoming unconditionally supportive of his transgender son. He is available for media interviews, speaking engagements, and parent coaching. Contact: ricardo@ricardoramosauthor.com
